subject: NebulaOps CAIQ intake — scheduling & evidence onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick Chung <patrick@nebulaops.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake — getting our evidence in order

Hi Sergio / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting the CAIQ intake for NebulaOps as part of our procurement process and need a short onboarding call to align owners and timelines. Quick items we want to cover on the call: 
- Confirm which CAIQ sections Redwood will own vs. NebulaOps (networking, key management, logging, etc.)
- Evidence handoff format (Drive link vs. SFTP) and naming convention
- Sampling window and log extract format for telemetry
- Timeline: target to complete CAIQ + evidence bundle within 3 weeks if possible

I've attached our blank CAIQ template with a couple of pre-filled fields to show our expectation (column for evidence links + owner). If possible we prefer a call early next week — we're in PST.

Proposed times: Mon 6/16 10:00-11:00 PT, Tue 6/17 09:00-10:00 PT, or Wed 6/18 14:00-15:00 PT.

Also: we require a recording consent checkbox for demos; please confirm.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Security Program Manager, NebulaOps
Attachments: NebulaOps_CAIQ_Template.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>, Patrick Chung <patrick@nebulaops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — getting our evidence in order

Thanks Elena — appreciate the template. We can take the Mon 6/16 10:00 PT slot. I'll put a calendar invite shortly. Quick assignments for the call: 
- Marissa Cole (Security Ops lead) will be Redwood's evidence owner and primary contact for the CAIQ mapping.
- Irene Choi (Infra / Logging SME) will cover telemetry/log sampling and export details.

Pre-call asks from our side: 
1) Can you confirm whether evidence transfer will be via the Drive link you shared or a secure SFTP? (Drive is easier for us but SFTP is fine for larger archives.)
2) Please flag any CAIQ sections that are higher priority (e.g., cryptography, key mgmt) so we can prepare artifacts.

We'll attach our standard evidence index (CSV) that maps Redwood artifacts to CAIQ questions — that should make the handoff quicker.

On recording consent: we are fine with recordings for internal review; we'll include consent in the invite.

See you on Monday.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-evidence-index.csv (preview)

From: Patrick Chung <patrick@nebulaops.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — getting our evidence in order

Thanks — Mon 10:00 PT works for us. A couple of technical notes ahead of the call: 
- For telemetry we'll need a 24-hour sample (UTC timestamps preferred) and a short walk-through of how you separate customer tokens from telemetry in logs.
- NebulaOps requires an initial dataflow diagram (high-level) and confirmation of KMS providers for any customer keys referenced in CAIQ.

I've attached our internal intake checklist (PDF) — not required but may help. Also — we have a compliance blackout window next week (Friday) so throughput on evidence transfers may be slower; we'd like to aim for the first full bundle by Fri 6/27 if possible.

Patrick
Patrick Chung
Procurement Lead, NebulaOps
Attachments: NebulaOps_Intake_Checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>, Patrick Chung <patrick@nebulaops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — getting our evidence in order

(Notes from today's intake call — 2025-06-16 10:00 PT)

Attendees: Sergio Alvarez (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Irene Choi (Redwood), Elena Morales (NebulaOps), Patrick Chung (NebulaOps)

Summary of decisions and action items:
- Evidence transfer: NebulaOps will create a shared Drive folder (they will invite redwood-security@redwood.com). Drive preferred for CAIQ artifacts. (Elena)
- CAIQ mapping: Redwood will fill the CAIQ template with links to artifacts in the Drive and mark an owner per question. (Marissa)
- Telemetry sample: Redwood (Irene) to provide a 24-hour syslog export (UTC) with PII redaction notes and an example of token/ID hashing. Deliverable: logs_sample_20250615.tar.gz uploaded to NebulaOps Drive. Target: 6/19 EOD.
- KMS & crypto: Redwood uses AWS KMS for customer key wrapping in hosted mode; dedicated customers may use customer-managed KMS. Deliverable: kms_summary.pdf (Marissa). Target: 6/20.
- Timeline: mutual action plan agreed — initial CAIQ mapping + sample logs by 6/20, complete evidence bundle by 6/27.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Redwood: populate CAIQ template (sections A–F) with evidence links, provide logs sample, provide kms_summary.pdf — owners: Marissa, Irene.
- NebulaOps: confirm access to Drive, review artifacts, provide prioritized question list and any additional compliance constraints — owners: Elena, Patrick.

Attachments referenced / next steps:
- Redwood will upload redwood-evidence-index.csv to the Drive with CAIQ question -> artifact mappings.
- NebulaOps will post a prioritization CSV if they have urgent sections; otherwise default priority applies.

Recording consent: agreed; call recorded for NebulaOps review.

Quoted for context:
> On Sat, Jun 14, 2025 at 09:12 AM Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com> wrote:
> > Proposed times: Mon 6/16 10:00-11:00 PT, Tue 6/17 09:00-10:00 PT, or Wed 6/18 14:00-15:00 PT.

Action owners and deadlines (short list):
- Marissa: CAIQ mapping + upload redwood-evidence-index.csv (due 2025-06-19)
- Irene: telemetry sample and redaction notes (due 2025-06-19)
- Sergio: confirm Drive share and follow up on any outstanding asks (due 2025-06-16)
- Elena: share prioritized question list if any (due 2025-06-20)

If there are any corrections to the notes above please reply-all.

Thanks,
— Sergio

From: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick Chung <patrick@nebulaops.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — getting our evidence in order

Thanks for the clear notes — that matches our view. A few quick confirmations: 
- Drive invite sent to redwood-security@redwood.com (check spam if you don't see it).
- Priority sections for us: Cryptography (A3–A5), Data Retention (B2), and Logging/Error Handling (D1–D3). We'll upload a "priority_questions.csv" to the Drive by 6/20.
- For the telemetry sample: we expect the following fields (if possible): timestamp_utc, request_id (hashed), user_agent, path, status_code, service_name. If any field cannot be included for privacy reasons, please list the rationale in the redaction notes.

Owners (as requested):
- NebulaOps evidence reviewer: Elena Morales (elena@nebulaops.com)
- Procurement/comms: Patrick Chung (patrick@nebulaops.com)
- Redwood evidence owners (confirm): Marissa Cole, Irene Choi

Definition of Done for initial bundle: 
1) CAIQ template populated with working Drive links for each referenced artifact.
2) 24-hour telemetry sample uploaded with redaction notes.
3) KMS summary document uploaded.

We look forward to the uploads. If anything blocks you, ping Patrick or me.

Best,
Elena
